scope: All149 old parameter/control groups individually decided for prospective code. Delete means absent from active new path; frozen generations and historical evidence remain unchanged. These changes do not revalidate or revoke old admissions.

parameters.old_value: Gaia DR3 source; KIC/TIC cross-identities; exact extraction owner distinguished
parameters.prospective_v2: Authenticate exact source, extraction and all cross-identities; no parent-host substitution.
parameters.scientific_basis: Required source authentication; a parent TPF KIC is not the source identity.

parameters.old_value: rust_rows: rank 1 and psf_flat; BOI suffix -1
parameters.prospective_v2: No rank-1 or PSF_FLAT selection. Consume supplied run-scoped signal ID for survey and M/K.
parameters.scientific_basis: This local selector is survey-specific, not a generic M/K or multi-signal implementation. Consume the actual run-scoped signal instead.

parameters.prospective_v2: One native SAP/source-corrected path; explicit flux convention and dilution once.
parameters.scientific_basis: Raw SAP and crowding-corrected flux require different dilution conventions; never double-correct.

parameters.parameter: Bootstrap period, epoch, duration and resolution
parameters.old_value: Detector values; all exact current values in embedded run_input
parameters.prospective_v2: Use authenticated supplied P/epoch/duration only to bootstrap the fit; preserve original clock.
parameters.scientific_basis: Authenticate clock/time system and fitted signal; no universal numerical value.

parameters.prospective_v2: List actual other signals explicitly; never mask unexplained residuals automatically.
parameters.scientific_basis: Must bind other real signals for multi-signal candidates; never automatically mask unexplained structure.

parameters.prospective_v2: No universal k=.08 initialization; standard sampler/priors supplied per candidate.
parameters.scientific_basis: Starting point, not a measured radius; ensure it does not determine the only explored mode.

parameters.prospective_v2: Measured stellar density prior or joint stellar posterior; no catalogue starting-point shortcut.
parameters.scientific_basis: Starting point separate from the density prior.

parameters.old_value: VET_OK, finite time/flux/errors, error>0; SAP VET_OK uses QUALITY==0
parameters.prospective_v2: Authenticated delivered validity mask, finite photons/errors. No extra QUALITY=0 mandate in wrapper.
parameters.scientific_basis: Strict quality-zero is our mask, not a TRICERATOPS prerequisite. Retain masks and quantify lost events.

parameters.old_value: Median of valid native quarter flux
parameters.prospective_v2: Protected Lightkurve trend normalization, retaining photons, trend, errors and original indices.
parameters.scientific_basis: Normalized input is required; this normalization is one implementation, needing activity/systematics checks.

parameters.prospective_v2: Native fit window +/-3 supplied durations; inspect coverage/uncertainty, not fixed .3 days.
parameters.scientific_basis: Use duration-aware windows with real pre/post baseline; no universal fixed-hour recommendation in API.

parameters.prospective_v2: Protect +/-1 supplied duration plus half exposure in trend fit; no fixed .12-day noise boundary.
parameters.scientific_basis: Must protect the entire transit plus integration/clock uncertainty. A 9.288h event contaminates this nominal OOT region.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove universal eight-cadence event gate; review actual coverage/information.
parameters.scientific_basis: Coverage criterion is not an API requirement; inspect actual information rather than treating this as physical rejection.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove four-cadence fixed outer-region gate; fit needs genuine baseline, reviewed per candidate.
parameters.scientific_basis: Sensible need for baseline, arbitrary fixed placement; short periods and gaps can fail the implementation.

parameters.old_value: At least one point within supplied T14/2 + exposure/2
parameters.prospective_v2: Retain primary coverage in native fit review; supplied duration is not immutable truth.
parameters.scientific_basis: Retain coverage evidence. A detector duration need not equal the final transit duration.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove scaled .3-day local baseline operator; use standard detrending/native nuisance parameters.
parameters.scientific_basis: Linear baseline is not universally adequate for active/correlated Kepler SAP.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove fixed MAD quarter-jitter construction; noise adequacy and juliet jitter are candidate decisions.
parameters.scientific_basis: Robust scatter has a basis; fixed white jitter does not model time-correlated stellar/instrument noise.

parameters.prospective_v2: Standard free P_p1 prior covering measured timing/aliases; no detector-resolution box.
parameters.scientific_basis: A local bound is defensible only after timing/alias review and boundary checks; detector grid spacing is not a posterior uncertainty.

parameters.prospective_v2: Standard free t0_p1 prior near data centre; no universal +/-2-hour box.
parameters.scientific_basis: Must cover plausible clock uncertainty; no fixed two-hour API requirement.

parameters.prospective_v2: Standard p_p1 prior justified per candidate; no .005-.3 or compulsory log(k) wrapper box.
parameters.scientific_basis: Not the stock physical planet-radius prior. k ceiling can exclude large planets around small M stars or truncate grazing fits.

parameters.prospective_v2: Standard b_p1 prior and physical transit geometry; no padded fractional-impact coordinate.
parameters.scientific_basis: Allows grazing events, excludes exact endpoints. Not itself a V-shape veto.

parameters.old_value: .1 < rho/rho_sun < 50; log-density coordinate times stellar density prior
parameters.prospective_v2: Standard SI rho prior from stellar evidence; no .1-50 solar-density wrapper box.
parameters.scientific_basis: Broad for many dwarfs but excludes evolved stars and sufficiently dense small M dwarfs; bounds need candidate/model justification.

parameters.prospective_v2: Standard Kepler LD parameters/prior, supported for host; no .001 endpoint padding requirement.
parameters.scientific_basis: Triangular physical LD sampling is established; endpoint padding is ours.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove bounded shared multiplicative noise scale; use reviewed standard nuisance/noise model.
parameters.scientific_basis: A bounded shared scale is not a universal TRICERATOPS requirement; check clipping and quarter dependence.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove .0104-.25-day duration veto. Duration derives from fitted physical geometry.
parameters.scientific_basis: Inherited code box, no documented universal scientific justification. Review a duration-aware model rather than crop events or silently widen a frozen run.

parameters.old_value: e=0, omega=90deg; dark single transit; apparent unit dilution
parameters.prospective_v2: Eccentricity, omega and native dilution explicitly declared; circularity is not universal truth.
parameters.scientific_basis: Circular native fitting has a paper analogue, but does not prove adequacy for every eccentric/blended object. Probability model subsequently has eccentric/dilution alternatives.

parameters.old_value: intercept .1; slope .5 in scaled x; mean [1,0]; analytically marginalized
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove analytic baseline Gaussian widths .1/.5 and their custom marginalizer.
parameters.scientific_basis: Proper nuisance integration is preferable to an undefined prior, but these widths/model need external sensitivity controls.

parameters.old_value: First ExoFOP row with mass and radius
parameters.prospective_v2: Choose authenticated supported stellar measurements by evidence, not first ExoFOP row.
parameters.scientific_basis: Ordering is not evidence ranking; authenticate the adopted catalogue/source and handle disagreements.

parameters.old_value: Always 10% of mass in this preparer
parameters.prospective_v2: Use reported mass error; missing errors need explicit justified uncertainty model, no silent 10%.
parameters.scientific_basis: Use reported uncertainty when present. The reference fallback does not justify overwriting measurements.

parameters.old_value: Always 6% of radius in this preparer
parameters.prospective_v2: Use reported radius error; missing errors need explicit justified uncertainty model, no silent 6%.
parameters.scientific_basis: Use reported uncertainty when present; the scene builder already does so. C12 has missing M/R errors, so fallback is applicable there.

parameters.old_value: Independent positive Gaussian M and R
parameters.prospective_v2: Use covariance/asymmetric or joint posterior when available; helper is explicitly first-order independent-error approximation.
parameters.scientific_basis: Joint stellar covariance/systematics are not represented; physically coherent posterior samples are preferable where available.

parameters.old_value: 2049 log-rho grid points; 1024 vs 2048 Legendre nodes; radius centre +/-9 sigma, lower .001Rsun
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom density quadrature/grid; supply ordinary juliet density prior or posterior-derived distribution.
parameters.scientific_basis: Resolution comparison checks this integral, not the astrophysical validity of independent M/R or the density box.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove hardcoded three MAP starts and impact guesses.
parameters.scientific_basis: Multiple starts help, but do not prove discovery of all transit/alias modes.

parameters.old_value: Nelder-Mead; maxiter2500, then4000 if best unsuccessful; xatol1e-5,fatol1e-4
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom Nelder-Mead optimizer/retry controls; delegate native inference to juliet.
parameters.scientific_basis: No paper requires these settings; diagnose finite support and optimization separately.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom MAP simplex scales.
parameters.scientific_basis: Optimization controls, not physical restrictions.

parameters.old_value: strict JSON allow_nan=False; rejected attempts may contain -inf
parameters.prospective_v2: Preserve upstream failures; JSON records encode nonfinite diagnostic values explicitly without changing model.
parameters.scientific_basis: Represent rejected support explicitly in a reviewed serializer; do not label a finite model all-infinite because the writer failed.

parameters.prospective_v2: Standard sampler ensemble/nested configuration and convergence evidence; no mandatory four-by-24 geometry.
parameters.scientific_basis: Different sampler from the reference is acceptable if posterior exploration and diagnostics are adequate.

parameters.prospective_v2: Standard sampler moves/options, documented per fit.
parameters.scientific_basis: Sampler controls; not a TRICERATOPS prerequisite.

parameters.prospective_v2: Explicit preserved native seed; no candidate-specific copied hardcoded initializer seeds.
parameters.scientific_basis: Preserve all seeds and continuation RNG states.

parameters.prospective_v2: Preserve sampler seed/output; do not change seeds to get a favourable fit.
parameters.scientific_basis: No replacing unsuccessful chains with favourable seeds.

parameters.old_value: Native [2,.12,.12,.12,.25,.15,.15,.015]; fresh duration-coordinate starts [2,.12,.08,.12,.2,.15,.15,.02] before exact transformation
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove hardcoded initialization spread; use supplied standard sampler controls.
parameters.scientific_basis: Exact defaults and expressions preserved in static appendix.

parameters.prospective_v2: Convergence budget appropriate to sampler/candidate, not universal 3k/6k/12k/24k endpoints.
parameters.scientific_basis: Finite compute budget may hold a real planet; it is not a physical false-positive test.

parameters.prospective_v2: Burn-in/discard based on convergence evidence; not fixed half-chain policy.
parameters.scientific_basis: Check stationarity and effective independent draws; step count alone is insufficient.

parameters.old_value: One predeclared walker from each ensemble; all rank Rhat<=1.03, epoch bulk ESS>=100
parameters.prospective_v2: Inspect independent-chain mixing/ESS where appropriate; no mandatory old rank-Rhat/epoch-ESS gate or misuse of ensemble walkers.
parameters.scientific_basis: Paper-style numerical thresholds; correlated walkers are not independent chains. Diagnostic construction differs from NUTS.

parameters.prospective_v2: Report quantile-width radius SNR and inspect radius posterior; no custom fixed-max SNR gate substituting for scientific review.
parameters.scientific_basis: Not required by calc_probs. The reference applies median(k)/half(16th-84th percentile width)>3 in its final fit; our median/std differs. This may hold a real grazing planet; C10 fails both definitions.

parameters.old_value: Rhat<1.01 and chain length>50*tau is reported separately, not the adopted framework gate
parameters.prospective_v2: Preserve relevant standard sampler diagnostics, residuals, boundary and timing checks.
parameters.scientific_basis: Do not report the weaker adopted gate as proof the stronger one passed.

parameters.old_value: 65 period x65 epoch grid, epoch +/-1.999h; shape/noise fixed at mode
parameters.prospective_v2: Review aliases/timing from data; no fixed local grid/offset scan as a universal acceptance gate.
parameters.scientific_basis: This is a local conditional profile, not a global alias search or marginalized timing evidence.

parameters.prospective_v2: Quarter timing/coverage and TTV review when warranted; no universal +/-90-minute seven-point profile.
parameters.scientific_basis: Quarter timing coverage and uncertainty matter; no universal fixed-hour grid.

parameters.old_value: TDB/BKJD, BJDREF2454833, mid-exposure;270 frames;6.538751429414s spacing,6.01980290327s live
parameters.prospective_v2: Real cadence/exposure/time system and acquisition metadata remain measured inputs.
parameters.scientific_basis: Use the actual delivered cadence/exposure; do not inherit TESS exposure defaults for Kepler long cadence.

parameters.old_value: 5 frames/group,54 group centres;270-centre and finite-live-frame checks
parameters.prospective_v2: Actual exposure, standard batman/juliet supersampling checked per ingress/cadence; no universal54 requirement.
parameters.scientific_basis: Resolution must be checked at the accepted posterior and ingress shapes, not justified solely by a large number.

parameters.old_value: Accepted joint posterior median P and central reference epoch, no FPP selection
parameters.prospective_v2: Adopt accepted joint-posterior median P/central epoch before FPP; never choose timing by FPP.
parameters.scientific_basis: A defensible adopted ephemeris; no choosing the clock that minimises FPP.

parameters.old_value: Retain native primary groups; append other original-valid photons in .6d quarter cells
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove full-phase sparse-cell/custom affine packet. Direct duration-scaled folded native data.
parameters.scientific_basis: Additional bookkeeping enables common transforms; it is not an upstream requirement.

parameters.old_value: Merge cells with fewer than3 points into nearest adjacent same-quarter cell
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove sparse added cells and invented missing quarter noise.
parameters.scientific_basis: A numerical/model choice; preserve actual timing and group membership.

parameters.old_value: Native normalization and fixed OOT jitter on all usable photons
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove fixed native-quarter noise reuse requirement; normalize measured errors and review noise.
parameters.scientific_basis: Requires adequacy away from the primary as well as in native windows.

parameters.old_value: Native physical MAP circular template; quadratic LD
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove fixed native MAP template from probability likelihood.
parameters.scientific_basis: Template uncertainty is not marginalized by internal transform parity.

parameters.old_value: Native effective errors times exp(MAP log-noise)
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom jitter/noise export. Declare supported folded-noise sigma/basis in native review; formal bin errors are not automatically total noise.
parameters.scientific_basis: Probability evidence fixes this scale; no full noise posterior marginalization.

parameters.old_value: Affine ridge-MAP baseline, prior precision diag[100,4]; same nonlinear y/H(y) for data/models
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom affine MAP baseline transformation from probability likelihood.
parameters.scientific_basis: Applying the same operator is necessary, but does not prove an unbiased astrophysical evidence calculation.

parameters.old_value: First-order Jacobian J at observed MAP; B J diag(sigma^2) J^T B^T
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom covariance likelihood/projector; use stock normalized-light-curve likelihood with noise adequacy review.
parameters.scientific_basis: Propagates detrending correlations, not a time-correlated stellar-noise GP or full nuisance posterior.

parameters.prospective_v2: Probability window +/-2 fitted durations, with fit coverage checked beforehand.
parameters.scientific_basis: A duration-scaled probability window has a direct reference analogue; inspect lost longer alternatives.

parameters.old_value: 200 total equal phase bins over4T14; omit empty bins
parameters.prospective_v2: At most200 total folded bins; preserve fewer actual points; no fabricated empty cells.
parameters.scientific_basis: Current C12 occupies178 bins. Check numerical effect for long-cadence, short ingress and grazing shapes.

parameters.old_value: Inverse corrected conditional variance; keep full pooled covariance
parameters.prospective_v2: Inverse-variance binning of measured conditional errors; preserve contributing photon indices.
parameters.scientific_basis: Stock API accepts scalar scatter; this is a more complex likelihood, requiring matched-data controls.

parameters.old_value: No added sigma clipping in this packet; original masks remain
parameters.prospective_v2: No arbitrary flux clipping gate or custom bound-driven clipping in preparation.
parameters.scientific_basis: No obligation to copy TESS clipping. Inspect outliers without hypothesis-dependent removal.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove eigenmode retention/cutoff machinery.
parameters.scientific_basis: Drops low-variance modes, not just exact null modes. Test evidence sensitivity; normalization cancellation alone does not recover discarded information.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove covariance-specific tolerances with removed covariance model.
parameters.scientific_basis: Retain checks; these are not physical cuts.

parameters.prospective_v2: Direct upstream known-object parity replaces same-custom-operator reproduction test.
parameters.scientific_basis: Necessary operator check, not empirical calibration.

parameters.prospective_v2: Stock scalar likelihood with candidate-specific measured/justified total folded noise; assess red noise/activity before acceptance, no automatic white-noise adequacy claim.
parameters.scientific_basis: Config noise_quadrature_nodes128 does not make this active likelihood noise-marginalized.

parameters.old_value: Drop only entire independent groups with exactly zero bin projection; Q1 null at both declared clocks
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom complete-group/null-quarter covariance reduction; direct fold selects actual contributing photons.
parameters.scientific_basis: C12 full-reference observed/model/covariance differences were exactly zero. This recovery is not a new physical validation.

parameters.old_value: All original Gaia scene IDs + target; C12:31 sources
parameters.prospective_v2: Complete actual scene with potential contaminants and true apertures; no universal 120-arcsec census claim.
parameters.scientific_basis: Audit flux outside the retained60arcsec field and catalogue completeness; no missing source may silently vanish.

parameters.prospective_v2: TIC lookup not mandatory for Gaia-authenticated background source; optional catalogue measurements preserved.
parameters.scientific_basis: Compare with actual extraction and contamination radius, not an arbitrary universal angular radius.

parameters.prospective_v2: Exact source/crossmatch identity; do not substitute parent or ambiguous cross-identities.
parameters.scientific_basis: Astrometric/crossmatch ambiguities require review; a proximity alone is not sufficient.

parameters.prospective_v2: Actual measured stellar/photometric fields with provenance and supported model domain.
parameters.scientific_basis: Exact field values and missingness embedded in audit; catalogue estimates are not all independent measurements.

parameters.old_value: Only unique official DUPLICATE->canonical pointer with exactly agreeing source fields
parameters.prospective_v2: Resolve official duplicate identities explicitly without dropping conflicting/ambiguous sources.
parameters.scientific_basis: Legitimate identity safeguard, not a planet-selection cut. Preserve raw aliases.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove mandatory4096-particle scene banks.
parameters.scientific_basis: Finite bank error is not removed by1M evidence draws. Check effective support/convergence separately.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove scene-bank RNG seeds because banks are absent.
parameters.scientific_basis: Fixed numerical approximation; preserve it, do not pick a favourable bank.

parameters.old_value: TIC for active C12; alternatives GAIA_FLAME/POPULATION exist
parameters.prospective_v2: Adopt evidence-based host measurements; no required TIC/Gaia/empirical particle-route contest.
parameters.scientific_basis: Choose from authenticated stellar evidence before seeing FPP; no universally correct family.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove parallaxSNR>=5 route gate; supported physical target parallax remains needed by bound-companion prior.
parameters.scientific_basis: Not a general TRICERATOPS validation requirement. Low-SNR distance needs a proper posterior/prior rather than a failed inverse-parallax route.

parameters.old_value: TIC EBV required, even for Gaia-family route
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove mandatory measured TIC EBV for every scene source.
parameters.scientific_basis: Driven by our BC model. Missing TIC EBV is not evidence a planet cannot be validated; do not equate Gaia A0 to Av.

parameters.prospective_v2: Positive finite M/R/Teff for potentially capable sources; no custom TIC route restriction.
parameters.scientific_basis: Physical host properties are needed; stock offers estimation routes. Coherent alternative estimation requires review, not fabricated values.

parameters.old_value: FLAME M,R and GSP-Phot Teff with lower/upper bounds
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove Gaia GSP-Phot route restrictions/mandatory logg-mass construction.
parameters.scientific_basis: More restrictive than a universal API contract; quality/systematic errors of Gaia APs still need consideration.

parameters.old_value: Reported errors; only missing errors use10%M/6%R
parameters.prospective_v2: Preserve measured stellar uncertainties in native fit/scene provenance; stock probability takes its documented point inputs.
parameters.scientific_basis: This differs from native preparer which always assigns10/6. Fallbacks are assumptions, not measured precision.

parameters.old_value: TIC MH/error else Gaia GSP-Phot MH with bounds; no defaultSolar fill
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove mandatory measured metallicity gate/MIST bank conditioning; document stock metallicity assumptions.
parameters.scientific_basis: Our BC/LD model needs a declared metallicity prior; stock target code setsZ=0. Missing MH need not imply no defensible prior.

parameters.old_value: Fixed conditional value when centre exists without error
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove invented fixed Teff/MH/EBV error assignments from particle banks.
parameters.scientific_basis: Not zero measured uncertainty. Propagate justified systematics/uncertainty in a reviewed model.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove q16/q84 symmetric-Gaussian Gaia bank approximation.
parameters.scientific_basis: Approximates marginal quantiles; does not reconstruct joint catalogue posterior or include systematic calibration.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove independent multiparameter scene-bank construction; use documented stock input/model assumptions.
parameters.scientific_basis: Can create inconsistent stellar combinations and discard catalogue correlations; require sensitivity/physical checks.

parameters.old_value: Positive truncated Gaussian parallax then1000/plx pc; no Galactic distance prior
parameters.prospective_v2: No positive-Gaussian distance redraw; use stock parallax input and its documented approximation.
parameters.scientific_basis: Limited high-SNR route, not a low-SNR distance solution.

parameters.prospective_v2: No custom per-particle reddening law; choose actual upstream-compatible population and document extinction assumptions.
parameters.scientific_basis: ConventionalRv3.1, not a measured source-specific extinction law.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom derived-gravity bank; upstream model handles its own stellar relations/LD lookup.
parameters.scientific_basis: Correct units; still inherits sampled M/R consistency.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove equal-weight4096-particle catalogue banks.
parameters.scientific_basis: Physical luminosity inconsistency is not automatically repaired by observed-G anchoring.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove empirical population G smoothing bandwidth.
parameters.scientific_basis: This is a model bandwidth, not measured Gaia photometric uncertainty. Needs adequacy/sensitivity tests.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove empirical BP-RP smoothing bandwidth.
parameters.scientific_basis: Declared empirical approximation, not TRICERATOPS default.

parameters.old_value: Measured Gaussian parallax likelihood, including negative values
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove empirical population parallax reweighting.
parameters.scientific_basis: Avoids inverse-parallax failure but finite catalogue/selection prior remains a scientific choice.

parameters.old_value: ESS and maximum weight reported; sparse ESS~1-2 retained
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove effective-particle route gate; inspect actual upstream population adequacy instead.
parameters.scientific_basis: Repeating integration cannot add stars to a sparse prior bank; no unreviewed automatic pruning/ESS veto.

parameters.prospective_v2: Preserve exact measured seismic neighbour identification and evidence; no automatic copied C12 override.
parameters.scientific_basis: Measured evidence is preferable to fabricating a giant from a main-sequence relation. Other30sources unchanged.

parameters.prospective_v2: Use source-specific measured M/R/Teff with provenance when appropriate; no forced override for new scenes.
parameters.scientific_basis: Source identifiers, original values/errors and catalogue receipt retained.

parameters.old_value: 4096, seed entropy[2026,10,19,11,0]; independent draws, scaledSolar BC; fixed EBV if error missing
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove seismic particle constructor and invented particle errors from new framework.
parameters.scientific_basis: Measurements do not supply absent joint covariance or a measured alpha-enhanced BC model.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove MIST/Gaia colour-grid engine; unchanged upstream flux relations with disclosed TESS-based limitations.
parameters.scientific_basis: Appropriate filters are necessary; numerical table support is not proof of stellar-model accuracy.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom bolometric-correction interpolation.
parameters.scientific_basis: Reasonable safety boundary; supply a scientifically justified alternative for unsupported objects, never erase them.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove mandatory MIST rectangular-domain gate; upstream model support still needs scientific review.
parameters.scientific_basis: Includes source-table padding. WDlogg9.57 and some metal-rich neighbors exceed this chosen table, not nature or TRICERATOPS.

parameters.prospective_v2: Use upstream physical relations/constants, no separate bolometric luminosity engine.
parameters.scientific_basis: Common within-band normalization cancels; distinguish colour magnitudes and physical cross-band fluxes.

parameters.old_value: Kp=observedG+BC_G-BC_Kp; composite totalG convention for unresolved scenarios
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove composite Gaia-G to Kepler anchoring likelihood.
parameters.scientific_basis: Composite SED is not refit to observations; blending/colour/multiplicity conditioning needs known-object controls.

parameters.old_value: Every Gaia row uniquely matches all12printed physical fields in separately returned Kepler table; AB-Vega=.122666mag
parameters.prospective_v2: One actual upstream population; remove paired-filter simulation/row-matching acquisition design.
parameters.scientific_basis: Exact identity check is sound; two independent simulations need not share stars. Prefer a reviewed common physical catalogue with both bands, rather than approximate joining/redrawing.

parameters.old_value: NearestZ,thenTeff,thenlogg; nearest outside grid, no uncertainty
parameters.prospective_v2: Use mission=Kepler upstream LD; verify cool-star/gravity/passband support per candidate.
parameters.scientific_basis: Using the Kepler table is right; nearest-edge lookup is not proof of cool-star/gravity support. Inspect actual coverage.

parameters.old_value: Actual source-quarter masks/WCS and published CCD PRF core; full resolved census
parameters.prospective_v2: Actual apertures/coordinates and reviewed upstream Gaussian OR measured Kepler fractions; no silent response fallback.
parameters.scientific_basis: Necessary for KBonus background extractions; stock TESS Gaussian is not a better Kepler-specific measurement.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove invented PRF tail-family priors.
parameters.scientific_basis: Distant-wing response extrapolation must be checked against data; not guaranteed by the published core PRF.

parameters.old_value: Independent uniform quarter atoms: nominal and+/-0.2pixels on each axis
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove invented pointing-mixture prior.
parameters.scientific_basis: Five states shared across sources within a quarter; not an inferred pointing-error distribution.

parameters.old_value: Uniform area disk radius2.2arcsec, sqrt(U) radial draw
parameters.prospective_v2: Use stock unresolved alignment/companion model; no custom spatial integration prior.
parameters.scientific_basis: 2.2arcsec is an inherited no-imaging convention, not a complete Gaia/Kepler exclusion guarantee.

parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom unresolved response interpolation grid.
parameters.scientific_basis: Require spatial resolution checks, particularly sharp aperture edges.

parameters.prospective_v2: Finite normalized measured aperture fractions or supported stock Gaussian; inspect true extraction, no hardcoded PRF-throughput veto.
parameters.scientific_basis: Do not turn unsupported response into zero contamination.

parameters.old_value: 3.5..4.25pixels; positive core; clipped negative polynomial samples recorded
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom PRF core/tail join.
parameters.scientific_basis: Physical positivity is necessary, but clipping/tail normalization require empirical comparison.

parameters.old_value: 5families; nominal exponential, envelope exponential, Moffatbeta2.5/1.5 and doubled slow envelope
parameters.prospective_v2: Remove custom wing sensitivity scenarios.
parameters.scientific_basis: Only nominal used in this production; other conventional families are sensitivities, not measured probabilities.

parameters.old_value: Radius64pixels with32/64/128convergence and analytic tail integral
parameters.prospective_v2: Normalize complete measured source fractions; document quarter averaging limits. No invented PRF integral normalization.
parameters.scientific_basis: Checks integration convergence of the assumed tail, not correctness of that tail.

parameters.old_value: TRILEGAL1.6; sky coordinates in Galactic degrees
parameters.prospective_v2: One official Gaia/TRILEGAL population route with preserved request/raw response; no silent missing-population scenarios.
parameters.scientific_basis: Established Galactic star-count model; preserve exact request rather than relabel as empirical truth.

parameters.prospective_v2: Population area/density basis from chosen official route, preserved explicitly; no duplicated two-filter requests.
parameters.scientific_basis: Area in density normalization must match request.

parameters.prospective_v2: Population selection/magnitude completeness justified for field; do not import survey-specific hard limits blindly.
parameters.scientific_basis: Audit completeness of selectable contaminants and native colour overlap; a finite faint limit is not exact zero contamination.

parameters.prospective_v2: One upstream-compatible photometric system/file; preserve upstream TESS flux approximation in Kepler mode.
parameters.scientific_basis: Same physical population across filters is needed for exact rowwise colours; independent jobs do not ensure that.

parameters.prospective_v2: Adopt documented field extinction/model assumptions; not mandatory per-source measured EBV.
parameters.scientific_basis: Full line-of-sight value is population boundary input, not every source extinction.

parameters.old_value: Exact75-entry request embedded, including Chabrier lognormal and disk/halo/bulge prescriptions
parameters.prospective_v2: Chosen official population model's IMF/Galaxy assumptions documented, not represented as measured truth.
parameters.scientific_basis: All exact keys are included below. Internal code replay does not validate each Galactic-model hyperparameter for this field.

parameters.old_value: binary_kind0; retained binary_frac.3 andq.7..1 inactive underkind0
parameters.prospective_v2: Document population binary assumptions to avoid hidden double counting with upstream binary scenarios.
parameters.scientific_basis: Do not double-count synthetic unresolved binaries and explicitly generated scenario companions.

parameters.old_value: 15target families plus3per resolved neighbor; C12=105; no dropping
parameters.prospective_v2: Full upstream 15 target plus3 per capable neighbour scenario structure, no removed astrophysical alternative.
